issues.issue: Confirmed: report p19 (the right half of the assets page) is missing. No JSON line needs it, because this is a GAAP report and the balance sheet comes from the Statement of Net Position. The substitute 42,454,149 is printed on p1 as Governmental Activities 'Total cash and investments' (38,182,707 + 41,219 + 4,230,223). It matches the funds statement: the implied Incentive cash 536,920 + TIF cash 15,558 (TIF fund balance end 15,558, p13) reconcile to the printed fund totals 1,273,275 / 26,425 (p5) and GW receivables. ending_cash carries a 'computed' tag although the amount is printed as-is (harmless). Re-trim with report p19 if the funds-statement cash is wanted.

The printed label isn't other/miscellaneous. It mixes capital facility (connection) charges and reimbursements, and the Statement of Activities (p2) shows it as Capital Grants and Contributions. Gretna_FY2024 records the same line as reimbursements/refunds, so the two years don't match. A person should choose one category, e.g. a capital contributions/charges category. The same applies to detail[60] Water 10,360,888 and detail[76] Sewer 2,109,807 (p17).
